alliance portfolio diversity can have both positive and negative effects on firm level innovation, which is dependent on the level of organizational search routines and technological capabilities.

the effect of alliance portfolio diversity is contingent on firms’ internal capabilities of value-creation.

the impact of alliance portfolio diversity is not always positive and the impact is contingent on the internal capabilities.
